name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'One MCP server: mtm' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between mtm markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## One MCP server: mtm

`mtm mcp serve` is the family's single MCP gateway: its `catalog`, `describe` and `run` tools reach mtm's own verbs and every registered extension's (o-lane `lane.*`, o-questions `questions.*`, o-cmds `cmds.*`, o-md `md.*`, o-git `git.*`). Use it rather than a tool's own MCP server.

name: Codex instructions note
description: Adds the same note to Codex's user instructions. Both items share one marker pair, so when both paths are the same file the note appears once.
